run_extract_pipeline_tests: run the script with --type pipeline to extract PipelineTesterMixin test methods as a pytest pattern
run_extract_model_tests: run the script with --type models to extract ModelTesterMixin test methods as a pytest pattern
run_extract_lora_tests: run the script with --type lora to extract PeftLoraLoaderMixinTests test methods as a pytest pattern
get_test_methods_from_class: get all test method names starting with test_ from a given Python class
generate_pytest_pattern: generate a pytest -k pattern string by joining test method names with or
